title: Grain Marketing Contracts: Amendment Windows, Ceilings and Fees
content:
An amendment is a written change registered against a live contract under Grain Marketing Contracts. How long after countersigning one may be registered, how many a contract may take and what each costs are catalogue terms of the marketing programme.

| Programme | Amendment window from countersigning (calendar days) | Amendments one contract may take (count) | Fee for registering an amendment (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Spot Cash Delivery Ticket | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Forward Cash Sale Contract | 10 | 2 | 35.00 |
| Basis Fixed Contract | 14 | 2 | 35.00 |
| Hedge-to-Arrive Contract | 14 | 3 | 50.00 |
| Delayed Price Agreement | 21 | 3 | 25.00 |
| Minimum Price Contract | 10 | 1 | 75.00 |
| Managed Accumulator Program | 7 | 1 | 150.00 |

The Spot Cash Delivery Ticket takes no amendment at all: its window, its ceiling and its fee are each nil.

## Points of judgement

The longest window in the catalogue belongs to the Delayed Price Agreement at 21 calendar days, which also carries the lowest fee at 25.00 and, with the Hedge-to-Arrive Contract, the highest ceiling at 3 amendments. The shortest window belongs to the Managed Accumulator Program at 7 calendar days, which carries the highest fee at 150.00 and a ceiling of a single amendment. The fee stands whether or not the change later proves unnecessary.
